_comment: Model-tier matrix for delegation-loop review calls. Row = task category, each tier is an ordered list of {model, effort} fallbacks. See issue #179 for the research behind these picks and #182 for the schema. Owner policy (2026-11-03): work routes use Haiku. Luna is not a default pick (owner rule, 2026-10-20). Sonnet and opencode-go are not listed. Opus and Fable need the owner's permission.

coding.note: bmo (tier0) is unverified. Its live endpoint serves swift-1.5-iq3_xxs, a quantized fine-tune. The Artificial Analysis score is for qwen3.8-flash-next, so it does not verify this tier. Haiku is the work model. Sonnet, Opus, and opencode-go are not listed. Opus needs the owner's permission. The OpenAI sol picks are fallbacks.

general.note: bmo (tier0) is unverified, as in coding. Haiku is the work model. Sonnet, Opus, and opencode-go are not listed. Opus needs the owner's permission. The Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index does not score the exact OpenAI model versions, so the sol picks are fallbacks.

frontend-ui.source: manual (mirrors ship/SKILL.md step 8 screenshot rule and delegation-loop/SKILL.md's visible-change effort floor)
frontend-ui.note: No tier0: UI review always escalates to tier2 on any user-visible change; there is no free-tier lane for this category. Haiku is the work model. Sonnet and Opus are not listed. Opus needs the owner's permission. No public score exists for this category. The OpenAI picks are fallbacks.

translation.source: Alconost Translation Quality Index + Linguist Evaluation (2025-2026 sample, alconost.com/en/blog/best-llm-for-translation-2026)
translation.note: No tier0 route. Alconost reports provider-family scores, not exact model-version scores, so these picks are not verified. Haiku is the work model. Sonnet and Opus are not listed. Opus needs the owner's permission. The OpenAI picks are fallbacks.

prose.source: LMArena Creative Writing leaderboard (BenchLeader snapshot, 2026-09-29) and EQ-Bench Creative Writing (Sept 2026) -- the two agree on a leader, unlike the translation sources
prose.note: The owner set the digest order: bmo, then DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, then Claude. No public creative-writing score covers the model that bmo serves, and bmo can sleep, so a failed bmo call falls to the next tier0 entry. Haiku is the work model. Opus and Fable are not listed. A route must not pick Fable without the user's approval (issue #114). Opus needs the owner's permission.

cad-spatial.note: P3D-Bench compares Claude Opus 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Pro, and Qwen3.6-Plus. These are different model versions from the routed models, so the scores do not verify this tier. bmo is the tier0 pick, and the benchmark does not identify its served model. Haiku is the work model. Sonnet and Opus are not listed. Opus needs the owner's permission.
